11th Floor - unfortunately while out running in Pattaya I tripped on the sidewalk and broke my femur neck bone.   The pain was terrible.  However, as soon as I arrived at Bangkok Pattaya Hospital I felt at ease.  All of the doctors who treated me, especially Dr Prida Phutthasirayakorn who performed my hip replacement, were exceptional.   In addition, all of the registered nurses and assistants who looked after me for the 4 days I was admitted took care of everything for me and made me feel at home.   It is unfortunate what happened, but I was so lucky to have received such exceptional service.   If you ever find yourself needing medical treatment in Pattaya, I highly recommend that you view Bangkok Pattaya hospital as you no 1 choice.
